Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The point values and the major and minor violation lists are only referenced to the DMV website, which was not followed, so no individual point values are stated [A01].
Telephone numbers and web addresses printed in these pages for the voting ID petition, car seat help and organ donor registration are not restated, because contact details can change [A02].
The child seat ages are introduced with the word generally and are restated with that qualifier; seat-specific weight and height limits are left to the seat manual [A03].
The organ donation paragraph contains a typo (make a different); its meaning is clear and is restated without the typo [A03].
Website-maintained lists and the newly described driver education grant are isolated as dynamic.
